title: Private 12-hours Tour to Kennedy Space Center from Miami
includes: Private transportation for a maximum of 12 hours with driver
Private pick up from Miami Dade
Private drop off in Miami Dade
Entrance ticket to Kennedy Space Center
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

blurb:
Enjoy these private tour from Miami Dade to the Kennedy Space Center. 

You will be picked up from your hotel or place of choice in Miami Dade and head towards the Kennedy Space Center to enjoy this 12 hour tour.

From Miami to the Kennedy Space Center you have approximately 3 hours and 20 minutes and the same to return. You will enjoy the tour in a comfortable vehicle with driver.

Entrance tickets to the Kennedy Space are included in the price of the tour.

Join us in this unique experience to the Space!
